about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I am a Frontend Developer with over 3 years of commercial experience, specializing in React. I became interested in programming during my first studies and quickly decided to pursue this path professionally.

I started my career as a Backend Developer, which gave me solid technical foundations and a good understanding of how applications work behind the scenes. At the same time, I had the opportunity to develop my frontend skills — and it was this area that turned out to be the most rewarding for me. Eventually, I decided to focus on building user interfaces, combining aesthetics with functionality.

I have experience working in a product-driven team environment, collaborating on a daily basis with other frontend and backend developers, as well as designers and the product team. I actively participated in code reviews, both as a reviewer and as someone receiving feedback, which helped me develop good engineering practices, responsibility for code quality, and strong technical communication skills.

I enjoy experimenting with new technologies, continuously expanding my skill set, and sharing knowledge with other team members. Outside of work, I strive to maintain a healthy balance — in my free time I enjoy rock climbing, hiking in the mountains, and spending time close to nature.
